actions.reason: _breakpoint_report: each resolved address entry is now an immutable tuple holding the location, its estimated and exact JSON sizes and its symbol text. All of these are computed once, when the address is first resolved. This removes the lazy size branch, the content-keyed size dict and its tuple keys. The redundant identity re-check after the id lookup is dropped: the entry keeps the address alive, so a matching id can only be the same object. The "retained list is full" flag is recomputed only when a location is appended, not on every iteration. Bound methods are hoisted out of the loop. Output, truncation and counting are unchanged; the equivalence harness reports identical outputs.
